reviewedContracts: Both source Front/Back skeletons were byte-bound through the original verified CharacterSpineAnimator/SkeletonAnimation/SkeletonDataAsset/TextAsset PPtrs. Normal OnAttack .567, S1 Begin .333, S2 Begin .433, S3 Begin .367 and S3 Startup .367 are literal original events, not guessed skill clocks.

Normal and S1/S2 hook attacks use CAST target selection, source BOTH motion and skill-specific farthest/blocked-priority selectors. S1 has exact charged capacity up to3 and selected force/ATK scalar; S2 has native flat BAT addition, selected two-target cap and extended3-14 range. Hook controllers retain waitProjectileInvalid/minimum1s post-delay fields.

Talent1 is a deployed global Abyssal Hunter regeneration aura and conditional Physical/Arts Sea Monster damage reduction; Talent2 filters target mass <=3 before selected1.3/1.36 ATK scaling. Non-HEAL aura and healing restrictions must remain separate.

S3 Sequence4575495158283420285 references FinalAttack-5091373855863291267 twice, first before Chant-4484485962964876675 and again after SwitchMode-3633245999185018243. Chant emits original bind link projectile_chr_glady_s3_1 plus original circle1.5 periodic Arts/pull projectile_chr_glady_s3_2. The periodic controller has waitFirstPeriod0, selected interval key and .5s pullDuration.

Original glady_s_3[end] template restores mode0 and finishes glady_s3[effect]. S3 retained links have stopIfTargetDead0/stopIfTargetDisappeared0; replacing them with ordinary target-death cancellation would contradict the original source.

blockers.reason: Native cached-position input, checkCanUseAbilityFlag and repeated FinalAttack dispatch are not executable-recovered. The graph does not establish whether the initial FinalAttack emits, skips, fails, or consumes a previously cached vortex position. Assuming a single initial bind followed by a final hook would erase an actual source sequence entry.

blockers.mechanism: S3 link lifetime and phase transitions
blockers.reason: Original links serialize delayTime0 and lifeTimeType2 while selected skill rows provide projectile_delay_time/hit_duration9. No executable binding proves link stop time, Sequence advancement or final-hook clock. Literal animation events alone cannot resolve these custom-controller lifetime transitions.

limitations: No partial generic kit is registered while the complete S3 source contract remains unresolved.
Native numeric selector, Sequence, projectile lifetime and continuous pull trajectory dispatch is not claimed to have game-frame parity.
All source skills/ranks/talents and native templates are retained; modules and original Unity particles are not enabled.
